meta.title: Tournaments
meta.description: Competitive brackets at Gamer's Exile. Free to enter, open to every skill level, and announced first in the Discord.

header.title: Test Your Skill. Earn Your Name.
header.lead: Brackets across a rotating slate of titles. Free to enter, refereed inside the server, and open to every skill level — from first-timers to the people who keep winning these.

upcoming.title: Open Brackets
upcoming.lead: Registration opens in the Discord roughly two weeks before each start time. Solo players can request a squad in the same channel.
upcoming.leadEmpty: The next brackets are being planned. Dates, games and prize pools are announced in the Discord first — grab the tournament role so you don't miss registration.

role.title: Take the tournament role
role.body: Grab it from the roles channel so you get bracket pings and schedule changes.

register.title: Register before lock
register.body: Sign up in the registration channel. Solo players can request placement on a squad in the same thread.

checkin.title: Check in on match day
checkin.body: Check-in opens an hour before the bracket starts. Miss it and your slot goes to the waitlist.

play.title: Play
play.body: Match rooms, referees and score reporting all run inside the server. Disputes get a mod, not a Twitter thread.

records.title: Previous Champions
records.caption: Completed tournaments with their champions and final scores
records.note: Every champion gets a permanent role in the server and a place on this list.

cta.heading: Think You Can Take It?
cta.lead: The next bracket opens soon. Join the Discord, grab the tournament role, and put your name in.

bracket.title: How the Last One Was Won
bracket.lead: The finals bracket from the most recent event, round by round.
bracket.scrollHint: Scroll the bracket sideways to see later rounds.
